name: Hiago Leão Ferreira
headline: Senior Frontend Software Engineer | React & React Native Specialist | TypeScript | Mobile & Web Applications
summary: I am a Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience, specializing in developing smooth, feature-rich interfaces for web and mobile applications using React and React Native. My expertise includes the entire React/JavaScript ecosystem, such as Redux, React Hook Form, Zustand, Reanimated, Expo, and Next.js.
